name: Milestone timeline · critical path with feeders and float
purpose: The eight major milestones as a chain down a spine, linked by Magenta arrows to mark the critical path (zero float), each with date and week, name and a one-line description. Feeder work sits to the left on hollow diamonds, joined to the milestone it gates by a dashed arrow, with its date and float.
